# FDG3059

> DO add the suffix “Stream.”

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.2 Names of Common Types. Applies to: System.IO.Stream.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1710
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

CA1710 reports a class derived directly from System.IO.Stream whose name does not end with Stream; with its default dotnet_code_quality.CA1710.exclude_indirect_base_types = true it does not report a class derived from another stream class, such as MemoryStream (probe with SDK 10.0.402), so coverage is partial. Renaming a public type changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; CA1710 has no code fix.
